articles.title: 1991년 당시 보도: 맨유의 신예 라이언 긱스, 승리로 출발하다

events.title: England beat Turkey 1–0 in İzmir in their fourth European Championship qualifying game.
아스널 edge closer to the title by drawing 0–0 with 선덜랜드, while 리버풀 are beaten 4–2 by 첼시.
리버풀 are beaten 2–1 by 노팅엄 포리스트, handing the title to 아스널, who beat 맨체스터 유나이티드 3–1. Alan Smith scores a hat-trick.
애스턴 빌라, First Division runners-up last season, confirm their survival with a 2–1 win at home to 노리치 시티. 셰필드 웬즈데이 seal an immediate return to the First Division with a 3–1 home win over 브리스틀 시티.

선덜랜드 are relegated to the Second Division as they lose to 맨체스터 시티 and 루턴 타운 beat 더비 카운티 2–0. It is the second season running that Luton have survived on the last day of the season with victory over 더비 카운티. 아스널 end their championship campaign with a 6–1 demolition of 코번트리 시티 at Highbury, with Anders Limpar scoring a hat-trick. The Second Division campaign ended with 올덤 애슬레틱, already promoted to the First Division for the first time since 1923, crowned as champions thanks to an injury-time final-day Neil Redfearn penalty earning them a 3–2 comeback victory over 셰필드 웬즈데이. 웨스트햄 유나이티드, last day losers to 4th-place 노츠 카운티, had to settle for second. 셰필드 웬즈데이 took the third automatic promotion spot. 헐 시티's relegation was confirmed 2 weeks ago, while 웨스트브로미치 앨비언 are relegated alongside them to fall into the Third Division for the first time in their history.
Gerry Francis resigns after four years as manager of 브리스틀 로버스, despite having guided the club a mid table finish in the Second Division a year after winning promotion.
맨체스터 유나이티드 mark the return to European football by English clubs with a 2–1 win over 바르셀로나 in the European Cup Winners' Cup final in Rotterdam . 마크 휴스 scores both goals.
토트넘 홋스퍼 wins 2–1 (after extra-time) over 노팅엄 포리스트 to claim the FA Cup .

토트넘 홋스퍼 win the FA Cup for the eighth time, beating 노팅엄 포리스트 2–1 after extra time in the final . 폴 개스코인 suffers cruciate knee ligament damage, causing his proposed £8.5million move to 라치오 to be put on hold.
The First Division campaign ends with a 1–1 draw between 맨체스터 유나이티드 and 토트넘 홋스퍼 at Old Trafford.
QPR manager Don Howe is sacked after 18 months in charge at Loftus Road .
Jozef Vengloš leaves 애스턴 빌라 after just one season as manager.
Brian Little , whose 달링턴 side have just secured their second successive promotion and won the Fourth Division title, is appointed as 레스터 시티's new manager.

Ron Atkinson , the 셰필드 웬즈데이 manager, turns down an offer to become the new 애스턴 빌라 manager. 토키 유나이티드 win promotion to the Third Division after nearly 20 years in the Fourth Division, beating 블랙풀 on penalties after a 2–2 draw in the Wembley playoff final.
